title: "The Bond Films"

::: {#7d788446 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```
:::


The Bond films in this dataset were released from 1995 to 2021.

::: {#cell-fig-bond-revenue .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Release year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
